chapter_title_en: The King of Chujiang of the Underworld
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Enters the Underworld to Find Keke – Chu Jiang Wang's Revelation
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen ventures into the failed underworld of Suiren, meets the only surviving King of the Ten, Chu Jiang Wang, and learns Keke's location at the Nine Serenity Platform. A hidden Buddhist temple reveals a mysterious leg.
og_title: Underworld Secrets: Xiao Chen Meets Chu Jiang Wang
og_description: In the desolate depths of the underworld, Xiao Chen seeks Keke and discovers the fallen realm of Suiren, the last king, and a temple of Dizang Wang with a shocking find.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen tracks Keke to the underworld's Nine Serenity Platform after meeting Chu Jiang Wang. A Buddhist temple hides a mysterious leg beneath the rubble.
